name: Golf Cart
requirements: Side-view pixel art facing right, about 30 to 70 px wide (our world: one art pixel is 1/16 unit). Prefer separate wheel sprites so a physics rig can be built, or a clean body plus wheel positions.
notes: Forged: golfcart_body.png 30x15 (roof, seat, steering wheel, white body), golfcart_wheel.png 7x7. Limits: Roof is a big flat green slab; no golf bag; steering wheel is a few pixels.
